newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific starts Louisiana yard project.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific starts Louisiana yard project.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp's Union Pacific Railroad said Friday it has begun a $20 million expansion of a yard in Louisiana, part of $500 million in investments related to its Southern Pacific Rail Corp merger.

The yard improvements include the addition of two departure, two receiving and six classification tracks, Union Pacific said. It also covers a locomotive fueling and service facility and other support tracks and facility additions.
The project is taking place at the company's Livonia, La., "high-tech" classification yard and is expected to be completed by December.
